glossary.sick: Flashy kills: os=one-shot (1 bullet + HS), ns=no-scope, as=air-shot, wb=wallbang
glossary.entries: Opening duels: fk=first kills (entry frags), fd=first deaths
glossary.clutches/clutchesLost: Clutches by enemy count: v1=1v1, v2=1v2, ... v5=1v5
glossary.multikills: Rounds with N kills: k1=1, k2=double, k3=triple, k4=quad, k5=ace
glossary.weapons[].hs: Headshot PERCENTAGE for this weapon (not a counter)
glossary.aim.crosshair/aim.ttd: Crosshair placement (deg) and time-to-damage (ms); null = too little data
glossary.aim.ttk: Time-to-kill (ms), spot -> kill of the same victim; null = too little data
glossary.rounds[].reason: Numeric round-end reason code; reasonLabel is alongside
glossary.team.startSide: Team side in the 1st half (CT|T); reversed in the 2nd
